findings.question: error-handling
findings.title: main guard compared argv[1] raw, so a junction path ran zero tests and exited 0
findings.evidence: fresh-context review 2026-11-02 (reproduced; fix re-proven by mutation pass 19/19)

findings.question: ownership
findings.title: the repo receipt test checked the newest name, which may be another PR's receipt
findings.evidence: fresh-context review 2026-11-02 (reproduced; fix re-proven by mutation pass 19/19)
findings.resolution: test now checks every receipt added versus origin/main; test job fetches full history

findings.question: error-handling
findings.title: on push to main the append-only base was main itself
findings.evidence: fresh-context review 2026-11-02 (reproduced; fix re-proven by mutation pass 19/19)

findings.question: under-engineering
findings.title: one git process per past entry (11.7 s at 99 entries)
findings.evidence: fresh-context review 2026-11-02 (reproduced; fix re-proven by mutation pass 19/19)
findings.resolution: one git diff plus one ls-tree (0.3 s)

findings.question: ownership
findings.title: the stamped-name regex had three owners with no parity check
findings.evidence: fresh-context review 2026-11-02 (reproduced; fix re-proven by mutation pass 19/19)

findings.question: error-handling
findings.title: files with another extension in an entry folder were silently skipped
findings.evidence: fresh-context review 2026-11-02 (reproduced; fix re-proven by mutation pass 19/19)
findings.resolution: every non-README file must be stamped, in all three readers

findings.question: ownership
findings.title: docs still described the single-log clean-append rule
findings.evidence: fresh-context review 2026-11-02 (reproduced; fix re-proven by mutation pass 19/19)

findings.question: error-handling
findings.title: a failed delete after the write left the changelog half released
findings.evidence: fresh-context review 2026-11-02 (reproduced; fix re-proven by mutation pass 19/19)
findings.resolution: restore CHANGELOG.md and deleted notes, then exit 2

findings.question: dependency
findings.title: found after the review, at the receipt step: the base ref is passed to git as an argument, so an option-looking value could be read as a git option (argument injection, e.g. --output=<file>)
findings.evidence: test/entry-log.test.mjs @security case: --output=<file> and -r fail closed and write no file
findings.resolution: --end-of-options before the ref in ls-tree and diff (entry-log.mjs, bdd-lib.mjs); ls-tree already fails on an option-only value, so the guard is defense in depth

verdict: 9 findings (0 high, 2 med, 7 low), all fixed
